lessons.title: 3. Generic Data Structures
lessons.description: Generics are types which take parameters. Implement a generic class Box<T> that stores a private value field assigned in the constructor and a getValue(): T method returning it. Declare the field explicitly (constructor parameter-property shorthand is not plain erasable TypeScript). Tests build Box<number> and Box<string>.

tests.name: test_generic_box

learning_objectives: Define generic classes that take a type parameter <T>
Initialize class fields in the constructor
Return typed values from instance methods

source.name: TypeScript Handbook — Generics — 'types which take parameters'

exercises.question: This lesson's `Box<T>` must stay in plain erasable TypeScript: the field is declared on the class and assigned in the constructor. Select every declaration the lesson allows.
options: private value: T; declared on the class
getValue(): T returning the stored value
correct_answer: private value: T; declared on the class
getValue(): T returning the stored value
exercises.explanation: Parameter-property shorthand is TypeScript-only syntax that no erasable-syntax runtime understands, so the field has to be declared and assigned explicitly.

lessons.title: 6. The Identity Function with Generics
lessons.description: The 'Hello World of Generics' is the identity function: a generic function identity<T>(arg: T): T that returns whatever is passed in, keeping the caller's type. Implement and export it (no type assertions needed - the parameter already has type T). The test calls it with <number> and <string>.
learning_objectives: Write a generic function with a type parameter <T>
Let the caller supply (or infer) the type argument
Return values typed T from generic functions

source.name: TypeScript Handbook — Generics — 'Hello World of Generics' (the identity function)

tests.name: test_identity
tests.unittest_code:
if (solution.identity<number>(7) !== 7) throw new Error('number identity');
if (solution.identity<string>('x') !== 'x') throw new Error('string identity');
